# Color Sets

# Load data
```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM1&2_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
```

# 1.Fruits 
## Prepare data
```{r}
########
# 16S #
########
ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, SampleType %in% c("Artific_Inf_Fruits_5_6days", "Nat_Uninf_Fruits_5_6days", "Fruits_0days", "Nat_Inf_Fruits_5_6days")) # subset data

ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly, function(x) 1*(x>0)) # counts -> presence/absence (binary table)

## Extract metadata
mtd_FruitsOnly_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin))
mtd_FruitsOnly_16S <- mtd_FruitsOnly_16S %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_FruitsOnly_16S = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_FruitsOnly_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_FruitsOnly_16S)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_FruitsOnly_16S = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_FruitsOnly_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_FruitsOnly_16S)
## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_FruitsOnly_16S = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_FruitsOnly_16S, df_reads_FruitsOnly_16S, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_FruitsOnly_16S$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_FruitsOnly_16S <- df_wide_FruitsOnly_16S[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_FruitsOnly_16S)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_FruitsOnly_16S$Genus <- make.unique(BF_FruitsOnly_16S$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_FruitsOnly_16S) <- BF_FruitsOnly_16S$Genus 
BF_FruitsOnly_16S$Genus <- NULL
#colnames(BF_16S) <- mtd_16S$Sample[match(colnames(BF_16S), mtd_16S$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_FruitsOnly_16S <- t(BF_FruitsOnly_16S)

# # Preview
# sbm::plotMyMatrix(FB_16S, dimLabels = c('taxon', 'sample') ,
#   plotOptions = list(rowNames = TRUE, colNames = TRUE,  legend = TRUE,  legend.position = 'right'))
```

```{r}
########

ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly, function(x) 1*(x>0)) # counts -> presence/absence (binary table)

mtd_FruitsOnly_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_FruitsOnly_bin))
```

## SBM clustering
```{r}
########
# 16S #
########
SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S <-  as.matrix(FB_FruitsOnly_16S) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S <- SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_FruitsOnly_16S <- SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S$memberships$col

SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)

SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S, BF_mat = BF_FruitsOnly_16S, mtd = mtd_FruitsOnly_16S, variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL", "CH", "ST"), color_string = c("purple4", "red4","red2"))

title_plot <- "SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitType.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", title_plot), SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitType, base_height = 21/cm(1),  base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 

SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitSite <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S, BF_mat = BF_FruitsOnly_16S, mtd = mtd_FruitsOnly_16S, variable_name = "FruitSite", modality_string = c("THU","FIN","LOM","IST","MIL","VAR"), color_string = c("skyblue","blue2","skyblue4","deepskyblue","coral2","dodgerblue"))

title_plot <- "SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitSite.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", title_plot), SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitSite, base_height = 20/cm(1), base_width = 55/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
 

SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitVariety <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S, BF_mat = BF_FruitsOnly_16S, mtd = mtd_FruitsOnly_16S, variable_name = "FruitVariety", modality_string = c("na", "CDP","HED","SUM","STA","SWE", "CIF","CIR","DRE","INF", "MDB", "UNK","LOC"), color_string = c("indianred", "gold","gold2", "lightgoldenrod1","indianred1","yellow2","deepskyblue","yellow","#CD2626","indianred4","firebrick1","skyblue"))     

title_plot <- "SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitVariety.png"
 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", title_plot), SBM_FruitsOnly_16S_FruitVariety, base_height = 21/cm(1), base_width = 29.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## Alluvial plot
```{r, eval=FALSE}

# 16S

## Extract rows (samples) and columns (OTUs) for the alluvial plot
memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_FruitsOnly_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_FruitsOnly_16S$memberships$col

# Cluster_Sample
dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpe <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin)$FruitType,memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S)) # data for alluvial plot (Freq = Number of samples associated with each line)

colnames(dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpe) = c("FruitType", "Cluster_sample", "SampleSize") # change column names

# Fruit Type
Alluvial_16S_FO_FruitType <- dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpe |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Cluster_sample,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fruit Type", "Bacteria"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL"="purple4","CH"="red4","ST"="red2"), guide = "none") 

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_FruitsOnly_FruitTYpe_16S.jpg"
 cowplot::save_plot(file=here::here("plots", "5_LBM&co", title_plot), Alluvial_16S_FO_FruitType, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
 
# Fruit Type x Fruit Site
dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpeSite <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin)$FruitType, sample_data(ps_rare_16S_FruitsOnly_bin)$FruitSite, memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S))
colnames(dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpeSite) = c("FruitType", "FruitSite", "Cluster_sample", "SampleSize")

Alluvial_16S_FO_FruitType_FruitSite <- dataalluvial_16S_FO_FruitTYpeSite |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Cluster_sample,
             axis3 = FruitSite,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fruit Type", "Bacteria", "Fruit Production Site"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL"="purple4","CH"="red4","ST"="red2"),guide = "none") 

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_FruitsOnly_FruitTYpe_FruitVariety_16S.jpg"
 cowplot::save_plot(file=here::here("plots", "5_LBM&co", title_plot), Alluvial_16S_FO_FruitType_FruitSite, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 50/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## CCA
```{r}
### Null model

NPERM <- 10

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_FruitsOnly_16S
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = T))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
    })
```

```{r}
# Factors
FruitType_vect_FruitsOnly_16S <- as.factor(mtd_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_FruitsOnly_16S), mtd_FruitsOnly_16S$Sample)])

FruitVariety_vect_FruitsOnly_16S <- as.factor(mtd_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitVariety[match(rownames(FB_FruitsOnly_16S), mtd_FruitsOnly_16S$Sample)])

## Create a matrix with samples as rows and group asigned by the latent block model as column
dummyMod_FruitsOnly_16S <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_FruitsOnly_16S), "FruitVariety" = as.factor(FruitVariety_vect_FruitsOnly_16S))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_FruitsOnly_16S <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_FruitsOnly_16S, cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitType, cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitVariety, chisquare = T)

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_FruitsOnly_16S <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_FruitsOnly_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S, var1=cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitType, var2=cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitVariety, configs = NULL)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_FruitsOnly_16S <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_FruitsOnly_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_FruitsOnly_16S, var1=cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitType, var2=cca_data_FruitsOnly_16S$FruitVariety, configs = LBM.config)
```

# 2. Individuals
## Prepare data
```{r}
# 16S

## Only Life Stage samples
ps_16S_rare_LS <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, LifeStage !="na")

ps_rare_16S_LS_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_16S_rare_LS, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

mtd_16S_LS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin))
mtd_16S_LS <- mtd_16S_LS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

df_taxo_16S_LS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_16S_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_16S_LS)

df_reads_16S_LS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_16S_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_16S_LS)

df_wide_16S_LS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_16S_LS, df_reads_16S_LS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_16S_LS$Species <- NULL

BF_16S_LS <- df_wide_16S_LS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_16S_LS)[2])]
BF_16S_LS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_16S_LS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_16S_LS) <- BF_16S_LS$Genus 
BF_16S_LS$Genus <- NULL
FB_16S_LS <- t(BF_16S_LS)
```

```{r}
# ITS

## Only Life Stage samples
ps_ITS_rare_LS <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage !="na")
ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_ITS_rare_LS, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

mtd_ITS_LS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin))
mtd_ITS_LS <- mtd_ITS_LS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

df_taxo_ITS_LS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_ITS_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_ITS_LS)

df_reads_ITS_LS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_ITS_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_ITS_LS)

df_wide_ITS_LS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_ITS_LS, df_reads_ITS_LS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_ITS_LS$Species <- NULL

BF_ITS_LS <- df_wide_ITS_LS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_ITS_LS)[2])]
BF_ITS_LS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_ITS_LS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_ITS_LS) <- BF_ITS_LS$Genus 
BF_ITS_LS$Genus <- NULL
FB_ITS_LS <- t(BF_ITS_LS)
```

## NMI
```{r}
NPERM=100#set quite low, so that permutations do not take too long, only for proof of principle, set to 10000 for serious comparisons

# Simulated version (parallelized version)
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)
sim_fun <- function(i, FB) {
  simulate(nullmodel(FB, "curveball"), nsim = 1)}

netBin.config_16S <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun, FB = FB_16S_LS)
graph.bin.16S.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun,  FB = FB_16S_LS)

netBin.config_ITS <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun, FB = FB_ITS_LS)
graph.bin.ITS.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun,  FB = FB_ITS_LS)
```

```{r}
# Factors
FT_vect_LS_16S <- as.factor(mtd_16S_LS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_16S_LS), rownames(mtd_16S_LS))])
FT_vect_LS_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_ITS_LS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_ITS_LS), rownames(mtd_ITS_LS))])

LS_vect_LS_16S <- as.factor(mtd_16S_LS$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_16S_LS), rownames(mtd_16S_LS))])
LS_vect_LS_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_ITS_LS$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_ITS_LS), rownames(mtd_ITS_LS))])

# Observed
nmi_obs_LS_16S_FruitType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_LS), FT_vect_LS_16S, method = "nmi")
nmi_obs_LS_ITS_FruitType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_LS), FT_vect_LS_ITS, method = "nmi")

nmi_obs_LS_16S_LifeStage <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_LS), LS_vect_LS_16S, method = "nmi")
nmi_obs_LS_ITS_LifeStage <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_LS), LS_vect_LS_ITS, method = "nmi")

## Simulated clustering
simulated_clustering_LS_16S <- Simulate_Clustering_SBM(FB = FB_16S_LS, NPERM, name = "simulated_clustering_LS_16S.tsv")
simulated_clustering_LS_ITS <- Simulate_Clustering_SBM(FB = FB_ITS_LS, NPERM, name = "simulated_clustering_LS_ITS.tsv")

# Simulated NMI
# Fruit Type
simulated_nmi_LS_16S_FT <- 
simulated_clustering_LS_16S %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FT_vect_LS_16S, method = "nmi"))

simulated_nmi_LS_ITS_FT <- 
simulated_clustering_LS_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FT_vect_LS_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_LS_16S_FruitType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_LS_16S_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_LS_16S_FruitType)))
print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_LS_ITS_FruitType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_LS_ITS_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_LS_ITS_FruitType)))


# Life Stage
simulated_nmi_LS_16S_LS <- 
simulated_clustering_LS_16S %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), LS_vect_LS_16S, method = "nmi"))

simulated_nmi_LS_ITS_LS <- 
simulated_clustering_LS_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), LS_vect_LS_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_LS_16S_LifeStage, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_LS_16S_LS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_LS_16S_LifeStage)))
print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_LS_ITS_LifeStage, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_LS_ITS_LS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_LS_ITS_LifeStage)))
```

## Alluvial plot
```{r}
# 16S

## Extract rows (samples) and columns (OTUs) for the alluvial plot
memb_spl_obs_16S_LS <- LBM_bernoulli_16S_LS$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_LS <- LBM_bernoulli_16S_LS$memberships$col

## Data for alluvial plot : Compute SampleSize, the number of samples for each FruitType, Lifestage and OTU membership
dataalluvial_16S_LS_FruitType_LifeStage <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)$FruitType,
      memb_spl_obs_16S_LS, sample_data(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)$LifeStage))

colnames(dataalluvial_16S_LS_FruitType_LifeStage) = c("FruitType", "Bacteria",  "LifeStage", "SampleSize") # change column names

# plot for fruits
Alluvial_16S_Fruits_LS_FruitType_LifeStage <- dataalluvial_16S_LS_FruitType_LifeStage |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Bacteria,
             axis3 = LifeStage,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(width = 0.4) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FruitType", "Bacteria", "Life stage"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2"),guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))
```

## CCA
```{r}
# 16S

NPERM <- 10

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_16S_LS
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = T))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
    })
```

```{r}
# 16S

# Factors
FruitType_vect_16S_LS <- as.factor(mtd_16S_LS$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_16S_LS), mtd_16S_LS$Sample)])
LifeStage_vect_16S_LS <- as.factor(mtd_16S_LS$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_16S_LS), mtd_16S_LS$Sample)])

## Create a matrix with samples as rows and group asigned by the latent block model as column
dummyMod_16S_LS <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_LS), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_LS)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_16S_LS <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_16S_LS),
    "LifeStage" = as.factor(LifeStage_vect_16S_LS))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_16S_LS <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_16S_LS, cca_data_16S_LS$FruitType, cca_data_16S_LS$LifeStage, chisquare = T)
varp_16S_LS$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S_LS <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S_LS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_LS, var1=cca_data_16S_LS$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_LS$LifeStage, configs = NULL)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_16S_LS <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S_LS), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_LS, var1=cca_data_16S_LS$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_LS$LifeStage, configs = LBM.config)
```

## NMI
```{r}
NPERM=100#set quite low, so that permutations do not take too long, only for proof of principle, set to 10000 for serious comparisons

# Import simulated clustering MPC
netBin.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_16S_expe,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)
graph.bin.gut.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_16S_expe,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)

graph.bin.bpk.config<-simulate(nullmodel(FB_16S_expe,"curveball"),nsim=NPERM)

# Parallelized version
plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 1)
sim_fun <- function(i, FB) {
  simulate(nullmodel(FB, "curveball"), nsim = 1)}

netBin.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun, FB = FB_16S_expe)
graph.bin.gut.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun,  FB = FB_16S_expe)

netBin.config.ITSexpe <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun, FB = FB_ITS_expe)
graph.bin.ITSexpe.config <- future_lapply(seq_len(NPERM), future.seed=TRUE, sim_fun,  FB = FB_ITS_expe)
```

```{r}
####comparisons with treatments
cle.config<-sapply(1:NPERM, function(x) cluster_leading_eigen(graph_from_incidence_matrix(as.matrix(netBin.config[,,x])))$mem[1:104])#memberships in communities for simulated datasets

compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$FruitType,method="nmi")#NMI of comparison with Type
wholenetmod.type.nmi.config<-sapply(1:NPERM, function(x) compare(cle.config[,x],netData$Type,method="nmi"))
1-ecdf(wholenetmod.type.nmi.config)(compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$Type,method="nmi"))#p-value of comparison with Type

compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$Diet,method="nmi")#NMI of comparison with Diet
wholenetmod.diet.nmi.config<-sapply(1:NPERM, function(x) compare(cle.config[,x],netData$Diet,method="nmi"))
1-ecdf(wholenetmod.diet.nmi.config)(compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$Diet,method="nmi"))#p-value of comparison with Diet

compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$Genotype,method="nmi")#NMI of comparison with Genotype
wholenetmod.genotype.nmi.config<-sapply(1:NPERM, function(x) compare(cle.config[,x],netData$Genotype,method="nmi"))
1-ecdf(wholenetmod.genotype.nmi.config)(compare(netData$mod.cle,netData$Genotype,method="nmi"))#p-value of comparison with Genotype
```

```{r}
# Factors
FT_vect_expe_16S <- as.factor(mtd_16S_expe$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_16S_expe), rownames(mtd_16S_expe))])
FT_vect_expe_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_ITS_expe$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_ITS_expe), rownames(mtd_ITS_expe))])

LS_vect_expe_16S <- as.factor(mtd_16S_expe$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_16S_expe), rownames(mtd_16S_expe))])
LS_vect_expe_ITS <- as.factor(mtd_ITS_expe$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_ITS_expe), rownames(mtd_ITS_expe))])

# Observed
nmi_obs_expe_16S_FruitType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_expe), FT_vect_expe_16S, method = "nmi")
nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_expe), FT_vect_expe_ITS, method = "nmi")

nmi_obs_expe_16S_LifeStage <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_expe), LS_vect_expe_16S, method = "nmi")
nmi_obs_expe_ITS_LifeStage <- compare(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_ITS_expe), LS_vect_expe_ITS, method = "nmi")

## Simulated clustering
simulated_clustering_expe_16S <- Simulate_Clustering_SBM(FB = FB_16S_expe, NPERM, name = "simulated_clustering_expe_16S.tsv")
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS <- Simulate_Clustering_SBM(FB = FB_ITS_expe, NPERM, name = "simulated_clustering_expe_ITS.tsv")

# Simulated NMI
# Fruit Type
simulated_nmi_expe_16S_FT <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_16S %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FT_vect_expe_16S, method = "nmi"))

simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FT <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), FT_vect_expe_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_16S_FruitType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_16S_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_16S_FruitType)))
print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_FT$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_FruitType)))


# Life Stage
simulated_nmi_expe_16S_LS <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_16S %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), LS_vect_expe_16S, method = "nmi"))

simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_LS <- 
simulated_clustering_expe_ITS %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Simulation", values_to = "Memberships") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Simulation) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(., nmi_sim = compare(as.factor(Memberships), LS_vect_expe_ITS, method = "nmi"))

print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_16S_LifeStage, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_16S_LS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_16S_LifeStage)))
print(c("NMI =", nmi_obs_expe_ITS_LifeStage, "P-value = ", 1 - ecdf(simulated_nmi_expe_ITS_LS$nmi_sim)(nmi_obs_expe_ITS_LifeStage)))
```

```{r}
# 16S

## Extract rows (samples) and columns (OTUs) for the alluvial plot
memb_spl_obs_16S_expe <- LBM_bernoulli_16S_expe$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_expe <- LBM_bernoulli_16S_expe$memberships$col

## Data for alluvial plot : Compute SampleSize, the number of samples for each FruitType, Lifestage and OTU membership
dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_expe_bin)$FruitType,
      memb_spl_obs_16S_expe, sample_data(ps_rare_16S_expe_bin)$SampleType))

colnames(dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType) = c("FruitType", "Bacteria",  "SampleType", "SampleSize") # change column names

# plot for fruits
Alluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType <- dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Bacteria,
             axis3 = SampleType,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(width = 0.4) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fruit Type", "Bacteria", "Sample Type"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2"),guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_Expe_FruitTYpe_SampleType_16S.jpg"
 cowplot::save_plot(file=here::here("plots", "5_LBM&co", title_plot), Alluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 50/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## CCA
```{r}
# 16S

NPERM <- 10

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_16S_expe
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = T))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row ## Extract membership of the samples 
    })
```

```{r}
# 16S

# Factors
FruitType_vect_16S_expe <- as.factor(mtd_16S_expe$FruitType[match(rownames(FB_16S_expe), mtd_16S_expe$Sample)])
LifeStage_vect_16S_expe <- as.factor(mtd_16S_expe$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_16S_expe), mtd_16S_expe$Sample)])

## Create a matrix with samples as rows and group asigned by the latent block model as column
dummyMod_16S_expe <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_expe), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_spl_obs_16S_expe)))

## Creates dataframe with the two variables of interest
cca_data_16S_expe <- data.frame("FruitType" = as.factor(FruitType_vect_16S_expe),
    "LifeStage" = as.factor(LifeStage_vect_16S_expe))

## Partition the variation of the community matrix
varp_16S_expe <- vegan::varpart(dummyMod_16S_expe, cca_data_16S_expe$FruitType, cca_data_16S_expe$LifeStage, chisquare = T)
varp_16S_expe$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S_expe <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S_expe), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_expe, var1=cca_data_16S_expe$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_expe$LifeStage, configs = NULL)

write.xlsx(wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S_expe, file=here::here("plots", "5_LBM&co"), rowNames = TRUE)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_16S_expe <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S_expe), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S_expe, var1=cca_data_16S_expe$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S_expe$LifeStage, configs = LBM.config)
```
